title: Understanding the Problem
text: The projectile is launched at an angle of $$30**\circ$$ and lands $$20$$ seconds later at the same height. We need to find the initial speed.

title: Breaking Down the Motion
text: The motion can be broken down into horizontal and vertical components. Use the angle to find these components.

title: Using Trigonometry
text: The horizontal component of velocity is v*cos(30) and the vertical component is v*sin(30).

title: Time of Flight
text: The time of flight for a projectile is given by the formula: $$t=2v\sin(\theta)/g$$, where $$g$$ is the acceleration due to gravity ($$9.8\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}**{2}}$$).

title: Calculate Initial Speed
text: Using the time of flight formula, solve for the initial speed v.
